# 14. Demo Script

## Demo flow
1. Explain the architecture.
2. Show raw S3 landing zone.
3. Explain local data generation.
4. Show Parquet and partitioned output.
5. Explain Glue catalog registration.
6. Run Athena query.
7. Discuss partition-pruning effect.
8. Review governance and monitoring.

## Trainer notes
Use the generated sample dataset to explain cost-aware analytics and serverless data engineering.
